meta_description: Value a stock with a multi-stage dividend discount model: one or two high-growth stages, then constant growth, with the PV of each dividend and terminal value.
subtitle: Value a stock whose dividend grows fast for a few years before settling at a constant long-term rate, with the present value of every dividend and the terminal value.
